functional_hypotheses.commands: Consumed eleven-bit start/stop masks; configuration alone cannot execute a transition
functional_hypotheses.state: Start adds running channels and cancels only their unfinished stops; stop selects only currently running channels
functional_hypotheses.latency: Each newly stopping channel owns a1us virtual deadline; repeated stop does not postpone it; independent deadlines share one QEMU timer
functional_hypotheses.completion: Expiry changes actual running/stopping state before publishing channel8/0 causes; other channels stop without invented causes
functional_hypotheses.reset: Cold zero, cancel all deadlines and qualification; finalize frees timer
functional_hypotheses.limits: No sequence pixel execution, SDES data publication, DMA, frame, host guest callback or software flag injection; physical command consumption and timing are not measured
